pre_mutation_validations.description: Ensure no duplicate object IDs (OBJ-TYPE_WITNESS_C, OBJ-project_w) exist in registry/formal_object_registry.json.
Ensure math note file docs/theory/foundational/5_03_26 unity/math/notes/0014_d_representable_distinction_candidate.md exists and matches its recorded hash.

post_mutation_validations.description: Verify that new registry objects parse correctly and validate against registry JSON schema.
Run scripts/global_validate.py to ensure ecosystem consistency is preserved.

negative_tests.assertion: RepDist_C does not imply existence of TYPE_WITNESS_C.
TraceCompatible_C does not independently prove TypedWitness_C.
AX-WITNESS-REPDIST does not encode transition preservation.
AX-REALIZATION-WITNESS does not require every realization to yield a witness.
No category, groupoid, associativity, identity, or invertibility law is introduced.
No witness equality w' = w is required by OBL-D-001D formation.
TypedWitness_C has exactly one final-argument type (Expr_D) in every axiom statement.
